description: SQL command line clients that take SQL as an argument or an option value (Snowflake `snowsql` and `snow`, Trino, Presto, Spark SQL, Hive, Beeline, Impala, `sqlcmd`, `usql`, `mycli`, `pgcli`, `litecli`, MariaDB, Vertica, ClickHouse): SQL that changes data, schema, or access.

rules.note: SQL in an argument or an option value (`-q`, `--query`, `-e`, `--execute`, `-Q`) that changes data, schema, or access. The first keyword of each statement decides.
`snow object drop` drops a Snowflake object. `snow stage remove` removes staged files.

writes.note: SQL in an argument or an option value that changes data, schema, or access in any way, such as `INSERT` or `CREATE` (policy v7). The destructive statements also have the flag `data_loss`.
